what: A small 5px-high wavy line flows endlessly sideways, half a width per 60 seconds, inside a short cell (3~14rem) — scattered decoration in the margins, used as an underline for buttons and menu items

options.--fx-delay: Delay (via style) — give a negative value and several flow from different positions
options.color: Wave color is the text color (currentColor) — default --kf-accent, on a blue panel color: var(--kf-on-accent)

use: · Button underline: See more
note: CSS only. Cell width (max-width) is set by the consumer — the original has four steps: 3·3.5·7·14rem (phone 2.3·2.5·5·10rem)

from.where: Every page .c-decoWave — ::before 5px high, 1350:6 wave image, loopSlideX 60s cubic-bezier(0,0,1,1) infinite (translate 0 → -50%), cell max-width 3/3.5/7/14rem
